tasks.title: Current of a white strip at a given brightness
tasks.solution: ws2811UpdateStrip(): v = v·brightness/100 (integer), white = R = G = B = v. The current of one LED = 3·v/255·20 mA, and of the strip — n times more. Example: 32 LEDs at 30 % → v = 76 → 572 mA.

tasks.title: How many LEDs the BEC can handle
tasks.solution: Available: (a − o)·1000·0.8 mA. One LED: v = 255·b/100 (integer), current 3·v/255·20 mA. Divide and round down — an LED cannot be partly powered. For example, 2 A − 0.9 A, 100 %: 880 / 60 = 14.

tasks.title: What the firmware stores for a led line
tasks.solution: DEFINE_LED(): LED_MOV_POS(CALCULATE_LED_XY(x, y)) = x·16 + y, LED_MOV_COLOR(c) = c·2²², and function C and empty directions/overlays give 0. If c were also 0 with x = y = 0, the result would be zero — and that entry would end the strip.

tasks.title: What rxfail actually stores
tasks.solution: CHANNEL_VALUE_TO_RXFAIL_STEP(v) = (constrain(v, 750, 2250) − 750) / 25 (integer), and back — 750 + 25·step. Example: 1990 → (1990 − 750) // 25 = 49 → 750 + 1225 = 1975 µs; 2500 → 2250 with no error. The channel number does not affect the answer — it only says that this is an AUX channel (c − 3), where h and s are allowed and a gives ###ERROR IN rxfail: PARSING FAILED###.

tasks.title: The beeper_off_flags mask
tasks.solution: BEEPER_GET_FLAG(mode) = 1 << (mode − 1): RX_LOST → 2, condition k → 2^(k−1); the mask is their sum (OR). Example: k = 18 (ON_USB in both versions) → 2 + 131072 = 131074 = 0x00020002. The number is taken from the enum, not from the table row — which is why ARMING_GPS_NO_FIX is bit 23 in 4.5 and bit 22 in 2025.12.

tasks.title: When the motors first beep (2025.12)
tasks.solution: beeperUpdate() in 2025.12 requests the beacon while the current sequence is RX_LOST and there is no USB; the gate is 1.2 s after the disarm (DSHOT_BEACON_GUARD_DELAY_US), and while it is closed lastDshotBeaconCommandTimeUs is held at “now − 450 ms”, so the beacon sounds on the very first tick after it opens. The answer is max(L + d/10, 1.2). Example: L = 0.5, d = 15 → max(2.0, 1.2) = 2.0 s; L = 0, d = 5 → 1.2 s.

variants.statement: Betaflight 2025.12, the FC has been on for a long time, USB is not plugged in, beacon RX_LOST is enabled. The disarm is at moment 0, the last good packet arrived {L} s after the disarm, failsafe_delay = 2 (tenths of a second). RX_LOST starts failsafe_delay after the last packet (no less than 0.1 s), and the beacon — no sooner than 1.2 s after the disarm. How many seconds after the disarm will the first DShot beacon sound? Ignore the task delays (10 ms).
